cumleler: Why does braiding electrode cables help an ABR recording?
In auditory brainstem response, or ABR, recording, the amplifier is differential.
It amplifies the voltage difference between two electrodes.
Mains interference reaching both leads equally largely cancels in this subtraction.
Braided cables bring interference to both leads alike, strengthening rejection.
So impedances must also be low and close to each other.
